issues.problem: Intro said the helper's initial vowel merges into て/で, which is false for てしまう → ちゃう (しま is not a vowel) and imprecise for ている (い simply drops).
issues.action: Reworded to 'the start of the helper drops out or fuses with the て or で'.

issues.problem: cs-sound explain claimed れ also becomes ん before ない/の; no common standard case, and it omitted る before な (するな → すんな).
issues.action: Restated the rule as ら before ない and る before の or な.

issues.problem: cs-tte contrast called と 'written', implying it is not used in speech.
issues.action: Changed to 'neutral and fine in writing; って is casual speech'.

issues.problem: cs-sound mistake 'まだその映画を見ない' was a poor model sentence (まだ + plain non-past 見ない is odd; 'haven't seen' is 見てない), and the slot boundary differed between bad and good.
issues.action: Replaced with 最近、テレビは見{んない} / 見{ない}, same slot boundary.

issues.problem: cs-sound tip ('say the full form in your head ...') was not a usable split-second test.
issues.action: Replaced with a register check plus the ら/る → ん restriction.
